claim.statement: Mayo collects node and per-app CPU and memory every 10 seconds into a per-node Parquet store (7 days by default), scrapes apps' Prometheus endpoints, and evaluates five fixed alert rules; there is nothing to install.

sources.quote: every 10 seconds, and keeps them for 7 days
Each node evaluates five built-in rules against its own metrics every 30

claim.measurable: relish top shows a sample per workload per node within about 10 s; metrics older than retention_days (7) are pruned; max_storage_mb defaults (metrics 1024, logs 2048) cap disk; alert rules fire at CPU>90% for 5 min, memory>85% for 2 min (critical), memory>70% for 10 min, disk>80% for 5 min, CPU<5% for 30 min (warning).
